The name long buchu is also applied to A. serrat- ifolia (B. serratifolia). The leaves of A. serratifolia are also used medicinally. Buchu leaf oil, usually from A. betulina, is occasionally promot- ed for use in aromatherapy, although it is rarely used in practice. Homoeopathy.
